title: Pocketwire Personal Account Plans and the Credited Refund Share on Business Profile Refunds
content:
On a refund from a Pocketwire Business Profile, the credited refund share follows the plan of the owner's Pocketwire Personal Account, as that account's record shows it. The refunded share is the refund amount divided by the sale amount.

| Plan of the owner's Pocketwire Personal Account | Credited refund share |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit | the whole percentage part is credited, whatever share was refunded (a share of 1) |
| Pocketwire Plus or Pocketwire Prime | the refunded share rounded up to the next whole tenth, never above the whole |
| any other plan | the refunded share, used exactly |

## Worked shares (hypothetical refunds)

| Sale | Refund | Refunded share | Onyx or Summit | Plus or Prime | Other plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 100.00 | USD 37.00 | 0.37 | 1 | 0.4 | 0.37 |
| USD 100.00 | USD 95.50 | 0.955 | 1 | 1 (never above the whole) | 0.955 |
| USD 250.00 | USD 12.50 | 0.05 | 1 | 0.1 | 0.05 |
